messages:
alina: Postmortem follow-up for incident 3120043210 - streaming timeouts & partial chunks during surge. Root cause: reconnect storms + aggressive keepalives -> KV cache churn. Need owners for 3 tracks: runtime heartbeat, client backoff, routing soft-fallbacks.
samir: Soft-fallbacks + throttles preferred over rollback.
devon: I own heartbeat tuning. Plan: idle_keepalive=15s, jitter=20%, max_missed=3; canary to staging; ETA Wed EOD.
marco: I own client backoff/SDK. Proposal: exponential backoff capped at 30s, max_attempts=6, client-side circuit-breaker if partial_rate>5% over 60s; add opt-in graceful-downgrade header; PR Tue AM.
sre_lead: Ops will own surge thresholds and routing rules to fall back to non-streaming/smaller-model path; runbook + alert required.
ops-bot: INF-5600 created: "Streaming surge thresholds & fallback runbook" https://redwood/INF-5600
oncall-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: heartbeat config to staging at 3130003000 UTC.
alina: Timeline recap: Devon (heartbeat Wed EOD), Marco (SDK Tue AM), Ops (runbook Fri EOD). 4-week observation window; rollback gate if partial_response_rate > 3% sustained.
alina: Priority: add partial-response tracing to close observability gaps. Please link PRs and test outputs to INF-5600 before Tue sync.
